datasets.name: country_analysis
queryLines:
SELECT
  country,
  event_year,
  event_date,
  venue_name,
  venue_city,
  attendance,
  show_id,
  source
FROM
  skztour.03_gold.shows_unified
WHERE
  country IS NOT NULL

datasets.name: yoy_growth
queryLines:
WITH yearly_totals AS (
  SELECT
    country,
    event_year,
    SUM(attendance) as total_attendance
  FROM
    skztour.03_gold.shows_unified
  WHERE
    country IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    country,
    event_year
),
growth_calc AS (
  SELECT
    country,
    event_year,
    total_attendance,
    LAG(total_attendance) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY event_year) as prev_year_attendance,
    CASE
      WHEN
        LAG(total_attendance) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY event_year) IS NOT NULL
      THEN
        (
          (total_attendance - LAG(total_attendance) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY event_year))
            * 100.0
            / LAG(total_attendance) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY event_year)
        )
      ELSE NULL
    END as yoy_growth_pct
  FROM
    yearly_totals
)
SELECT
  country,
  event_year,
  total_attendance,
  prev_year_attendance,
  yoy_growth_pct
FROM
  growth_calc
WHERE
  yoy_growth_pct IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  country,
  event_year

datasets.name: seasonal_patterns
queryLines:
SELECT
  MONTH(event_date) as month_num,
  DATE_FORMAT(event_date, 'MMMM') as month_name,
  CASE
    WHEN MONTH(event_date) IN (3, 4, 5) THEN 'Spring'
    WHEN MONTH(event_date) IN (6, 7, 8) THEN 'Summer'
    WHEN MONTH(event_date) IN (9, 10, 11) THEN 'Fall'
    ELSE 'Winter'
  END as season,
  country,
  event_year,
  attendance,
  show_id
FROM
  skztour.03_gold.shows_unified
WHERE
  event_date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  month_num

datasets.name: tour_cycle_analysis
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN event_year = 2022 THEN '2022 - Maniac Tour'
    WHEN event_year = 2023 THEN '2023 - 5-Star Tour'
    WHEN event_year = 2025 THEN '2025 - dominATE Tour'
    WHEN event_year = 2026 THEN '2026 - Latest Tour'
    ELSE CONCAT(CAST(event_year AS STRING), ' - Other')
  END as tour_cycle,
  event_year,
  country,
  venue_name,
  venue_city,
  event_date,
  attendance,
  show_id,
  source
FROM
  skztour.03_gold.shows_unified
WHERE
  event_year IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  event_year,
  event_date

datasets.name: venue_capacity_analysis
queryLines:
WITH venue_stats AS (
  SELECT
    venue_name,
    venue_city,
    country,
    COUNT(DISTINCT show_id) as total_shows,
    MAX(attendance) as max_attendance,
    AVG(attendance) as avg_attendance,
    MIN(attendance) as min_attendance,
    SUM(attendance) as total_attendance
  FROM
    skztour.03_gold.shows_unified
  WHERE
    venue_name IS NOT NULL
    AND attendance IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    venue_name,
    venue_city,
    country
),
capacity_estimates AS (
  SELECT
    venue_name,
    venue_city,
    country,
    total_shows,
    max_attendance as estimated_capacity,
    avg_attendance,
    min_attendance,
    total_attendance,
    ROUND((avg_attendance * 100.0 / max_attendance), 2) as avg_utilization_pct,
    CASE
      WHEN max_attendance >= 50000 THEN 'Stadium (50K+)'
      WHEN max_attendance >= 20000 THEN 'Large Arena (20K-50K)'
      WHEN max_attendance >= 10000 THEN 'Arena (10K-20K)'
      ELSE 'Theater (<10K)'
    END as venue_category
  FROM
    venue_stats
)
SELECT
  venue_name,
  venue_city,
  country,
  venue_category,
  total_shows,
  estimated_capacity,
  CAST(avg_attendance AS INT) as avg_attendance,
  avg_utilization_pct,
  total_attendance
FROM
  capacity_estimates
ORDER BY
  estimated_capacity DESC,
  avg_utilization_pct DESC

datasets.name: repeated_venues_markets
queryLines:
SELECT
  venue_name,
  venue_city,
  country,
  CONCAT(venue_city, ', ', country) as market,
  COUNT(DISTINCT show_id) as total_shows,
  SUM(attendance) as total_attendance,
  AVG(attendance) as avg_attendance_per_show,
  MIN(event_date) as first_show_date,
  MAX(event_date) as most_recent_show_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT event_year) as years_visited
FROM
  skztour.03_gold.shows_unified
WHERE
  venue_name IS NOT NULL
  AND venue_city IS NOT NULL
  AND attendance IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  venue_name,
  venue_city,
  country
HAVING
  COUNT(DISTINCT show_id) >= 2
ORDER BY
  total_shows DESC,
  total_attendance DESC

datasets.name: venue_type_success
queryLines:
WITH venue_stats AS (
  SELECT
    venue_name,
    venue_city,
    country,
    COUNT(DISTINCT show_id) as total_shows,
    MAX(attendance) as max_attendance,
    AVG(attendance) as avg_attendance,
    SUM(attendance) as total_attendance
  FROM
    skztour.03_gold.shows_unified
  WHERE
    venue_name IS NOT NULL
    AND attendance IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    venue_name,
    venue_city,
    country
),
venue_categories AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN max_attendance >= 50000 THEN 'Stadium (50K+)'
      WHEN max_attendance >= 20000 THEN 'Large Arena (20K-50K)'
      WHEN max_attendance >= 10000 THEN 'Arena (10K-20K)'
      ELSE 'Theater (<10K)'
    END as venue_type,
    venue_name,
    total_shows,
    max_attendance as estimated_capacity,
    avg_attendance,
    total_attendance,
    ROUND((avg_attendance * 100.0 / max_attendance), 2) as utilization_pct
  FROM
    venue_stats
)
SELECT
  venue_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT venue_name) as venue_count,
  SUM(total_shows) as total_shows,
  AVG(utilization_pct) as avg_utilization_rate,
  AVG(avg_attendance) as avg_attendance_per_show,
  SUM(total_attendance) as total_attendance,
  AVG(estimated_capacity) as avg_venue_capacity,
  CASE
    WHEN AVG(utilization_pct) >= 85 THEN 'High Success'
    WHEN AVG(utilization_pct) >= 70 THEN 'Medium Success'
    ELSE 'Moderate Success'
  END as success_tier
FROM
  venue_categories
GROUP BY
  venue_type
ORDER BY
  avg_utilization_rate DESC

datasets.name: venue_profitability
queryLines:
WITH venue_stats AS (
  SELECT
    venue_name,
    venue_city,
    country,
    COUNT(DISTINCT show_id) as total_shows,
    MAX(attendance) as max_attendance,
    AVG(attendance) as avg_attendance,
    SUM(attendance) as total_attendance
  FROM
    skztour.03_gold.shows_unified
  WHERE
    venue_name IS NOT NULL
    AND attendance IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    venue_name,
    venue_city,
    country
),
venue_categories AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN max_attendance >= 50000 THEN 'Stadium (50K+)'
      WHEN max_attendance >= 20000 THEN 'Large Arena (20K-50K)'
      WHEN max_attendance >= 10000 THEN 'Arena (10K-20K)'
      ELSE 'Theater (<10K)'
    END as venue_type,
    venue_name,
    total_shows,
    max_attendance as estimated_capacity,
    avg_attendance,
    total_attendance,
    ROUND((avg_attendance * 100.0 / max_attendance), 2) as utilization_pct,
    CASE
      WHEN max_attendance >= 50000 THEN 150
      WHEN max_attendance >= 20000 THEN 180
      WHEN max_attendance >= 10000 THEN 200
      ELSE 220
    END as est_avg_ticket_price
  FROM
    venue_stats
)
SELECT
  venue_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT venue_name) as venue_count,
  SUM(total_shows) as total_shows,
  SUM(total_attendance) as total_attendance,
  AVG(avg_attendance) as avg_attendance_per_show,
  AVG(utilization_pct) as avg_utilization_rate,
  AVG(estimated_capacity) as avg_venue_capacity,
  MAX(est_avg_ticket_price) as est_ticket_price,
  SUM(total_attendance * est_avg_ticket_price) as estimated_gross_revenue,
  SUM(total_attendance * est_avg_ticket_price) / SUM(total_shows) as revenue_per_show,
  ROUND(
    (SUM(total_attendance * est_avg_ticket_price) / SUM(total_shows)) / AVG(estimated_capacity),
    2
  ) as revenue_efficiency
FROM
  venue_categories
GROUP BY
  venue_type
ORDER BY
  estimated_gross_revenue DESC

datasets.name: attendance_trends
queryLines:
SELECT
  event_date,
  event_year,
  QUARTER(event_date) as quarter,
  country,
  venue_name,
  venue_city,
  attendance,
  show_id,
  SUM(attendance) OVER (
      ORDER BY event_date
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) as cumulative_attendance
FROM
  skztour.03_gold.shows_unified
WHERE
  event_date IS NOT NULL
  AND attendance IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  event_date

datasets.name: next_tour_recommendations
queryLines:
WITH country_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    country,
    COUNT(DISTINCT show_id) as total_shows,
    AVG(attendance) as avg_attendance,
    SUM(attendance) as total_attendance,
    MAX(event_date) as last_visit_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT venue_city) as cities_visited,
    COUNT(DISTINCT event_year) as years_active
  FROM
    skztour.03_gold.shows_unified
  WHERE
    country IS NOT NULL
    AND attendance IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    country
),
venue_performance AS (
  SELECT
    venue_name,
    venue_city,
    country,
    COUNT(DISTINCT show_id) as shows_held,
    AVG(attendance) as avg_attendance,
    MAX(attendance) as max_capacity,
    ROUND((AVG(attendance) * 100.0 / MAX(attendance)), 2) as utilization_rate,
    MAX(event_date) as last_show_date
  FROM
    skztour.03_gold.shows_unified
  WHERE
    venue_name IS NOT NULL
    AND attendance IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    venue_name,
    venue_city,
    country
),
country_scores AS (
  SELECT
    country,
    total_shows,
    avg_attendance,
    total_attendance,
    last_visit_date,
    cities_visited,
    years_active,
    DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), last_visit_date) as days_since_last_visit,
    -- Scoring factors (0-100 scale)
    LEAST(100, (avg_attendance / 300.0)) as attendance_score,
    LEAST(100, (total_shows * 10)) as market_proven_score,
    LEAST(100, (DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), last_visit_date) / 3.65)) as recency_score,
    CASE
      WHEN total_shows >= 30 THEN 100
      WHEN total_shows >= 20 THEN 80
      WHEN total_shows >= 10 THEN 60
      WHEN total_shows >= 5 THEN 40
      ELSE 20
    END as market_maturity_score
  FROM
    country_metrics
)
SELECT
  country,
  total_shows,
  CAST(avg_attendance AS INT) as avg_attendance,
  cities_visited,
  days_since_last_visit,
  ROUND(
    (attendance_score + market_proven_score + recency_score + market_maturity_score) / 4,
    2
  ) as overall_score,
  CASE
    WHEN
      (attendance_score + market_proven_score + recency_score + market_maturity_score) / 4 >= 80
    THEN
      'High Priority'
    WHEN
      (attendance_score + market_proven_score + recency_score + market_maturity_score) / 4 >= 60
    THEN
      'Medium Priority'
    ELSE 'Low Priority'
  END as recommendation_tier,
  CASE
    WHEN days_since_last_visit > 365 THEN 'Ready for Return'
    WHEN days_since_last_visit > 180 THEN 'Consider Soon'
    WHEN days_since_last_visit <= 180 THEN 'Recent Visit'
    ELSE 'Not Visited Recently'
  END as visit_timing,
  last_visit_date
FROM
  country_scores
ORDER BY
  overall_score DESC

datasets.name: specific_venue_recommendations
queryLines:
WITH venue_performance AS (
  SELECT
    venue_name,
    venue_city,
    country,
    COUNT(DISTINCT show_id) as shows_held,
    AVG(attendance) as avg_attendance,
    MAX(attendance) as max_capacity,
    SUM(attendance) as total_attendance,
    ROUND((AVG(attendance) * 100.0 / MAX(attendance)), 2) as utilization_rate,
    MAX(event_date) as last_show_date,
    MIN(event_date) as first_show_date,
    CASE
      WHEN MAX(attendance) >= 50000 THEN 'Stadium (50K+)'
      WHEN MAX(attendance) >= 20000 THEN 'Large Arena (20K-50K)'
      WHEN MAX(attendance) >= 10000 THEN 'Arena (10K-20K)'
      ELSE 'Theater (<10K)'
    END as venue_category
  FROM
    skztour.03_gold.shows_unified
  WHERE
    venue_name IS NOT NULL
    AND attendance IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    venue_name,
    venue_city,
    country
),
venue_scoring AS (
  SELECT
    venue_name,
    venue_city,
    country,
    venue_category,
    shows_held,
    CAST(avg_attendance AS INT) as avg_attendance,
    max_capacity,
    utilization_rate,
    total_attendance,
    DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), last_show_date) as days_since_last_show,
    -- Performance scoring (0-100 scale)
    LEAST(100, utilization_rate) as utilization_score,
    CASE
      WHEN shows_held >= 5 THEN 100
      WHEN shows_held >= 3 THEN 80
      WHEN shows_held >= 2 THEN 60
      ELSE 40
    END as proven_venue_score,
    LEAST(100, (avg_attendance / 300.0)) as attendance_strength_score,
    LEAST(100, (DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), last_show_date) / 3.65)) as return_readiness_score
  FROM
    venue_performance
)
SELECT
  venue_name,
  venue_city,
  country,
  CONCAT(venue_city, ', ', country) as market,
  venue_category,
  shows_held,
  avg_attendance,
  max_capacity,
  utilization_rate,
  days_since_last_show,
  ROUND(
    (utilization_score + proven_venue_score + attendance_strength_score + return_readiness_score)
      / 4,
    2
  ) as recommendation_score,
  CASE
    WHEN
      (utilization_score + proven_venue_score + attendance_strength_score + return_readiness_score)
        / 4 >= 85
    THEN
      'Top Choice'
    WHEN
      (utilization_score + proven_venue_score + attendance_strength_score + return_readiness_score)
        / 4 >= 70
    THEN
      'Strong Option'
    WHEN
      (utilization_score + proven_venue_score + attendance_strength_score + return_readiness_score)
        / 4 >= 55
    THEN
      'Consider'
    ELSE 'Lower Priority'
  END as recommendation_tier,
  CASE
    WHEN days_since_last_show > 365 THEN 'Ready Now'
    WHEN days_since_last_show > 180 THEN 'Soon'
    WHEN days_since_last_show <= 180 THEN 'Recent'
    ELSE 'New Venue'
  END as timing_recommendation
FROM
  venue_scoring
WHERE
  shows_held >= 1
ORDER BY
  recommendation_score DESC,
  utilization_rate DESC
